scenes.name: THE GLOBE
lines: On a flat map, a long flight looks bent. On the globe, it is the shortest arc.
平面地图上，长途航线看着是弯的；放回地球仪上，它才是最短的那段弧。
Picture a quantum state as an arrow of length one. Then states live on a sphere, too.
把一个量子态想成一支长度为一的箭头，态也就住在一个球面上。
So why assume the road between two states is a straight line?
凭什么认为两个态之间的路是一条直线？
Halfway along it, the arrow is only zero point eight six six long. That is no state at all.
走到直线的半路，箭头只剩 0.866 长——那根本不是一个态。

scenes.name: THE DISTANCE
lines: So measure the distance between two states by the angle between their arrows.
那就用箭头之间的夹角，来量两个态的距离。
These two are sixty degrees apart. Detour through a third state, and the trip grows to ninety-six point nine.
这两个态相距 60°。中途绕到第三个态，路程就涨到 96.9°。
Lean checks this for any three unit states: a layover never makes the trip shorter.
Lean 内核检验：任取三个单位态，中途转机从不让路程变短。
Between states, the shortest road is not a line. It is an arc.
态与态之间，最短的路不是直线，而是弧。

scenes.name: SPEED LIMIT
lines: Now add a speed limit: in time tau, a state turns by at most E tau over h bar.
再加一条限速：在时间 τ 内，态最多转过 Eτ/ħ。
Two orthogonal records sit ninety degrees apart. Tie a leash at any anchor; it must reach both.
两条正交记录相隔 90°。在任一锚点拴一根绳，绳得同时够到两头。
The best anchor sits halfway, and even there the leash needs forty-five degrees.
锚点放在正中最省，可即便如此，绳也至少要 45°。
Lean checks the consequence: tau is at least pi h bar over four E.
Lean 内核检验这个推论：τ 至少是 πħ/(4E)。

scenes.name: EVEN STEPS
lines: How should you walk the arc? Ask a beam of light passing through a row of polarizers.
这段弧该怎么走？问问一束穿过一排偏振片的光。
Each filter lets through the square of the overlap. Lean checks that this is the Born weight.
每片偏振片放过的，是重叠的平方。Lean 内核检验：这正是玻恩权重。
Turn sixty degrees in four even steps of fifteen: zero point seven five eight gets through.
Idle three times, then leap sixty degrees at once: only a quarter survives. A leap is not bold; it is expensive.
原地空转三次，最后一下猛跳 60°：只剩四分之一。跳步不是勇敢，是昂贵。
Same number of filters, total turn under ninety degrees: even steps always win. Twice as many half steps keep zero point eight seven two.
片数相同、总转角不到 90°，均匀总是赢；步数加倍、步子减半，留下 0.872。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: The book reads even steps as a picture of good reasoning. That reading is a model, not a theorem.
本书把均匀的步读作好推理的图像；这是一种模型读法，不是定理。
Keeping every step even does not make an answer right. A smooth drive can still end in the wrong town.
步子再均匀，也不等于答案正确：车开得再平稳，也可能开错了城。
And whether ternion-field networks, built on this geometry, perform well at scale is still an open problem.
以这套几何搭建的三元数场网络在大规模上表现如何，仍是开放问题。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter thirty-seven.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第三十七章
